Title: Azure Sphere OS version 20.12 is now available for evaluation

Body.Content:
The 20.12 Azure Sphere OS quality update is now available for evaluation in the Retail Eval feed. The retail evaluation period provides 14 days for backwards compatibility testing. During this time, please verify that your applications and devices operate properly with this release before it's deployed broadly via the Retail feed. The Retail feed will continue to deliver OS version 20.10 until we publish 20.12 in two weeks.  

For more information on what’s included in this release, please see our post under The Internet of Things on Microsoft Tech Commmunity. Azure Sphere OS feeds and setting up an evaluation device group, see Azure Sphere OS feeds. 

For self-help technical inquiries, please visit Microsoft Q&A or Stack Overflow. If you require technical support and have a support plan, please submit a support ticket in Microsoft Azure Support or work with your Microsoft Technical Account Manager. If you would like to purchase a support plan, please explore the Azure support plans.
